​Paint Work & Color Match

I was particularly concerned about orange peel and color matching on the bumpers, but the finish is incredibly smooth with a deep, glass-like reflection. ​Wheels: Deep cleaned inside the barrels, removing stubborn brake dust.
​Interior: The steam cleaning and leather conditioning left the cabin smelling fresh without that "chemical" scent. Even the hard-to-reach crevices in the center console were spotless.
​Final Verdict
​If you are looking to breathe new life into an older vehicle or protect a new investment, this service is worth every penny. The attention to detail—from the door jambs to the exhaust tips—is what separates this shop from a standard quick-wash. It’s a significant investment, but the boost in curb appeal and resale value is undeniable.
​Pros:

​Professional, transparent communication regarding timelines.

If you are looking for top-quality car detailing, denting, and painting services, I strongly recommend ULTRA CAR WASH AND SPA. They deliver showroom level results at a reasonable cost and treat your car as if it were their own. A truly five-star experience from start to finish!
